lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-ordered grid posterior to the branchial region, with spot size increasing and density decreasing towards the posterior mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like structure where spots serve as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular notch or indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin surface displays a significantly higher density of smaller, high-intensity punctate spots compared to the primary lateral flank.
